name: landmine kneeling thruster press
description: From a kneeling position, you drive the landmine bar up into a press. It builds shoulder power.
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive through your hips and press the bar up.
Straighten your arms fully at the top.
Lower back to your chest with control.
